caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing upright, facing forward, with both arms resting straight by her sides. She has light skin, brown hair styled in waves that fall over her shoulders, and a round face with blue eyes and pink cheeks. She is wearing a long, pale gray dress that reaches the floor, featuring large puffed sleeves and patterned with repeated decorative floral or abstract motifs in blue and red. The upper part of the dress is pink with lace trim and a large tan bow at the neckline, while a light beige section marks the waist, and the sleeve cuffs are pink. She wears loose, gray trousers beneath the dress, which gather at her ankles above pink shoes with small heels and crossed straps. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Doll
